skills.name: Power to Rule the World
skills.description: Attacks enemies with countless formulas. Bad effects on enemies.  *Continuously cancels enemy invincibility (5 sec) *Nullifies debuff-canceling skills (5 sec) *Changes Dark elemental enemies to None (7 sec) *ATK x 3800% Area Damage

skills.name: Science is Elegant
skills.description: Enters a meditative state, good effect on allies.  *Skill Resistance +60% (7 sec) *Allies' Skill Range +25% (7 sec)

abilities.name: Group: Dr. STONE
abilities.description: Dr. STONE Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and HP buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Deploy Stun: Strength
abilities.description: Has a high chance of stunning all Strength type enemies and canceling their invincibility skill effects when Rangers deploy. - Activates 5 seconds after battles start. - You must wait 6 seconds before you can use an Ability again after using one with the same effect on the same type of Ranger. - Bosses, Guardians, and special type enemies are not affected by this Ability.
